lines.beaver_en: The results of last week's parking lot accident are out.
lines.en: Really? What happened to the driver?

lines.beaver_en: I heard the driver paid a fine. Quite a lot.
lines.en: A fine? What about the victim? Badly hurt?

lines.beaver_en: Hurt a leg, but I hear it's fine now.
lines.learner: 다행이네요. 그런데 벌이 너무 가볍지 않나요?
lines.en: That's a relief. But isn't the punishment too light?
lines.roman: dahaengineyo. geureonde beori neomu gabyeopji annayo?

lines.beaver: 저도 그렇게 생각해요. 그 순간을 직접 봤거든요.
lines.beaver_en: I think so too. I saw that moment myself.
lines.beaver_roman: jeodo geureoke saenggakaeyo. geu sunganeul jikjeop bwatgeodeunyo.
lines.en: You saw it yourself, so you must have been shocked.

lines.beaver: 네, 차가 갑자기 와서 너무 무서웠어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, the car came suddenly. It was so scary.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, chaga gapjagi waseo neomu museowosseoyo.
lines.learner: 옛날 같으면 매를 맞는 벌을 받았겠죠?
lines.en: In the old days, he'd have been punished with a beating, right?
lines.roman: yennal gateumyeon maereul manneun beoreul badatgetjyo?

lines.beaver: 하하, 지금은 그런 벌은 법에 없죠.
lines.beaver_en: Haha, there's no such punishment in the law now.
lines.beaver_roman: haha, jigeumeun geureon beoreun beobe eopjyo.
lines.en: Right. The laws have changed a lot these days.

lines.beaver_en: I hear a new traffic law will be promulgated next month.
lines.learner: 새 법이 공포되면 벌금도 더 오르겠네요.
lines.en: Once the new law is promulgated, fines will go up too.
lines.roman: sae beobi gongpodoemyeon beolgeumdo deo oreugenneyo.

lines.beaver: 네, 오늘 뉴스 기사에 자세히 나왔어요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, there was a detailed news article about it today.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, oneul nyuseu gisae jasehi nawasseoyo.
lines.learner: 그 기사 읽을 만해요? 저도 보고 싶어요.
lines.en: Is that article worth reading? I want to see it too.
lines.roman: geu gisa ilgeul manhaeyo? jeodo bogo sipeoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼요. 피해자 인터뷰도 있어서 볼 만해요.
lines.beaver_en: Sure. There's a victim interview, so it's worth a look.
lines.beaver_roman: geureomyo. pihaeja inteobyudo isseoseo bol manhaeyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 피해자 이야기는 꼭 들어 보고 싶네요.
lines.en: Great. I really want to hear the victim's story.
lines.roman: joayo. pihaeja iyagineun kkok deureo bogo simneyo.

lines.beaver_en: I'll send you the link on messenger later.
lines.en: Thanks. Let's both drive carefully too.
